Gov. Lujan Grisham: 2028 Hopefuls Already Eyeing New Mexico
videos.description: New Mexico Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham says prospective 2028 Democratic presidential contenders are already making their presence felt in the state, naming Mark Kelly, Rahm Emanuel, Pete Buttigieg and Cory Booker among those who have been on the ground. New Mexico is set to vote fourth in the Democratic presidential primary calendar. She also discusses permitting reform and the growing data-center buildout with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Sol Trujillo Says Latino Economic Growth Is an Undervalued Investment Opportunity
videos.description: Sol Trujillo & Andy Sieg discuss Citi’s partnership with Trujillo to invest in and expand financial access for the Latino population in the United States. They said the opportunity is attractive but has been overlooked because investors have not segmented the data to see its scale. videos.title: Curnutt: Selloff May Be ‘Cleansing,’ But Risks Remain
videos.description: Dean Curnutt, founder and CEO of Macro Risk Advisors, says the market selloff could prove “cleansing” by resetting valuations and making room for fresh capital, but warns that the growing overlap between the AI trade and the broader economy could leave markets vulnerable to further downside. He also sees short-dated Treasuries as a haven if the Federal Reserve is forced to reverse course. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
